boards.title: D · The little Peer, out of his laptop (recommended)
boards.line: The AI Peer's own app icon comes to life and climbs out of the laptop's screen: a small, soft, clearly non-human helper whose face is the product's mark, the same on the cards, in Zoom and in Slack. In the morning it waves and dives back into the screen.

stills.caption: It climbs out of the laptop
It works at the desk all night
Morning: it dives back into the screen

boards.title: A · Ram's look, out of his phone
boards.line: The phone lights up for the night's meeting; a ribbon of light streams out of it and the Peer takes shape on the floor, looking like Ram, with the tag. In the morning it smiles at him and flows back into the phone in his hand, where the brief is waiting.

stills.caption: A ribbon from the phone; he takes shape
He works at the desk (Draft 2's still)
Morning: he flows back into the phone

boards.title: B · Ram's look, out of his laptop
boards.line: The laptop on the desk wakes by itself and the Peer takes shape in its light, already seated and ready to work. In the morning he stands, smiles at Ram, and streams back into the laptop's screen.

stills.caption: The laptop wakes; he takes shape in its light
He works at the desk (Draft 2's still)
Morning: he streams back into the laptop

boards.title: C · A night owl of light, out of his phone
boards.line: A small owl made of light steps out of the phone: the night owl that stays up so he can sleep, and hears the one change in a thousand. In the morning it flies back into the phone in his hand. Risk: an owl mascot is Duolingo's, and a white owl bringing messages is Harry Potter's.

stills.caption: It steps out of the phone (closer)
Morning: it flies back into the phone
